releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.32 — an empty app is never silent again. If a screen has nothing to show, the reason is on screen: the failing request and its status, with Retry and Sign out. A refused refresh token (expired, revoked, or rotated by another client) now sends you back to sign in with a message instead of leaving you on a home screen that looks wiped — nothing was deleted, and one sign-in brings the whole account back. Token refreshes are also written to disk synchronously, so an app update or force-stop can no longer lose the rotated credential that keeps you signed in.
